finite_boundaries.selected_event: Every actual checkpoint follows successful whole-allocatable DEALLOCATE, not an explicit final-procedure CALL or END BLOCK.

source_and_oracle_premises: Allocation and deallocation status are checked, and every primitive token is defined through its named component/element before the event. Setup does not assign a finalizable whole object, construct a result or use a structure constructor.

Final dummies are nonpolymorphic TYPE, nonoptional, nonpointer, nonallocatable and noncoarray, with legal INOUT and all LEN parameters assumed. KIND tags are abstract type parameters, not intrinsic representation selectors.

Own selection compares the full KIND tuple and rank before elemental/assumed-rank fallback. An ordinary scalar final is not an elemental fallback; an assumed-rank final does not coexist with another same-KIND final.
An exact array final has one invocation on its array even when zero-sized. A zero-element elemental fallback has no scalar calls; nonzero exact and elemental controls make absence nonvacuous.
Each scalar or array-valued component of each outer array element is finalized separately. No aggregated component array is substituted.

Own processing precedes declared eligible components, and those precede the actual recursive parent process. Inherited components are not traversed twice and parent finals are not inherited own finals. Parent-order fixtures use ordinary scalar objects and parents.
Callbacks read only current self, safe SIZE/RANK/type-parameter properties and separate saved nonfinalizable INTEGER logs. They do not read or define a peer already finalized.

The pointer exclusion has a positive containing callback and an independently reachable, allocated ALLOCATABLE TARGET. A later legal deallocation proves the target observer; no saved nonallocated target is deallocated through a pointer.
Private final procedure names remain available to automatic finalization; the client neither imports nor explicitly calls the private procedure.
S7.5.6.2-004 is correctly a run positive control for legal independent callbacks, not evidence of a forbidden-access effect, a mandatory report or a trap.
